entries.title: The window keeps up with the crew on a long history
entries.body: Each time a crewmate noted progress or a task changed, the app rebuilt the whole task board from your record. With thousands of tasks behind you, that paused the window for a moment every time, and typing in the message box could wait on it. The board now updates only the tasks a change reached and keeps the rest as they were.
entries.noPicture: This removes time the window spends busy; nothing on screen changes.
